facts.content: A short variable occupies two bytes. An int variable occupies four bytes. Implicit casting automatically converts a value to a larger primitive type without explicit syntax. Byte can be implicitly converted to short, short to int, int to long, and similarly for floating‑point types. Implicit casting occurs when no data loss will happen. Explicit casting requires a cast operator and is used when converting from a larger to a smaller numeric type. Explicit casting is only possible between compatible primitive types; you cannot cast a String to a numeric type directly. To convert a numeric String to an int, use Integer.parseInt(String).
